//: Capability manifest for stacked_bar/1 (the .pa-stacked-bar container) — keen-pure-admin (DataViz.stacked_bar/1). See list.map.json / data-bar.map.json for the model. CONTAINER-ONLY slice: stacked_bar/1 renders <div class="pa-stacked-bar [--size] [--rounded] {class}" {@rest}> with an `inner_block` slot. The segments + legend are SEPARATE components (stacked_segment / stacked_bar_legend / stacked_legend_item) fed through the slot — the dumper can't materialize them (slot content arrives as plain text), so the __segment / __legend* element classes are the DEFERRED child-component sub-slice, not mapped here. size is sm|lg; rounded is the is_rounded bool.
